prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: modular tall manga bookshelf illustration for a real scrolling product website. Create ONE highly polished hand-drawn Japanese manga ink illustration of an extended bookshelf, strictly flat straight-on 2D elevation, no perspective. Tall portrait 1:2 aspect ratio. The artwork is exactly THREE large stacked shelf compartments from top to bottom, each one-third of the image height. A single cohesive dark wooden frame has thin vertical uprights at x=3% and x=97%, shelf planks at y=0%,33.33%,66.67%,100%. Both vertical uprights continue beyond the top and bottom canvas edges: no top cap, no feet, no outside room, allowing vertical repetition into an endless bookcase. Every compartment contains a different carefully arranged collection of manga paperback SPINES of varying heights and widths, some small horizontal stacks and small deliberate gaps ready for extra books. Books are on shelves and visibly grouped into original matching series; several series have clean empty slots. Fine expressive dark ink outlines, delicate warm-paper hatching and halftone print texture, tasteful handcrafted manga background art, detailed tactile pages and bindings, quiet and sophisticated not toy-like. EXCLUSIVE palette: near-black plum #171217, dark plum #211A22 and #2A202B, Bordeaux #5A3948, muted plum #342735, muted rose #D7A0AF, warm eggshell paper #F7EEE8 and soft gray #C2B3B8. Strong eggshell-and-rose spines against dark shelf interiors so the books read clearly on the dark page. All book designs are completely original abstract fictional manga spines with botanical, star, stripe, small generic line motifs; NO readable text, NO lettering, NO logos, NO numbers, NO real manga characters, NO known franchise symbols, NO cover art, NO phones, NO interface, NO speech bubbles, NO figures, NO cat, NO glow. Artwork fills the frame edge to edge; flat dark #171217 shelf interiors are part of the drawing; NOT a photograph, NOT 3D, NOT isometric. Render the actual finished artwork, not a website mockup. Keep the three plank heights exactly even and enough clear outlined book silhouettes for web overlays.
